question: What does the design kit lack when it is used to propose several distinct skins and layouts for one surface, and which provider behaviors did that use expose?
method: Used the skill on one real brief that asked for several bold, different directions for a review surface. Made read-only calls only: DesignMD list_categories, search_designs, generate_css_variables, search_patterns, search_experiences and list_motion_systems; 21st search for components and themes; seven Mobbin search_screens calls. Recorded only behaviors that change how an agent should use the skill. No client material is recorded.
queries: DesignMD search_designs by feel words, then generate_css_variables for eight returned slugs
DesignMD search_patterns and search_experiences by intent, list_motion_systems
21st search by phrase for components and for themes
Mobbin search_screens for approval queues, batch review, story viewers, rundowns, chat cards and proofing grids
findings: The skill's steps converge on one system and one layout; nothing tells an agent how to produce directions that differ.
generate_css_variables returned no design for three of eight slugs that search_designs had just returned, and one export set foreground equal to background.
search_designs returned unrelated well-known systems for a phrase with no matching tag; tag words worked.
search_patterns answered an intent query with unrelated patterns but found patterns by their own names; search_experiences returned marketing templates.
21st theme search returned nothing for three multi-word queries and results for single words; component search by phrase returned close matches.
A host listed the Mobbin server as connected while the working session had no Mobbin tools; a separate headless run with the connection returned results.
Mobbin result links carried tracking parameters.
adopted: A section for requests that ask for several directions: name axes, differ on at least two, vary layout, one line of evidence per source, ideas before builds, keep an accepted direction as a skin.
Read a DesignMD export before use and fall back to get_design.
Provider notes on DesignMD search, patterns, experiences and motion, 21st theme search, Mobbin session access and link hygiene.
rejected: A fixed list of named styles in the skill; directions should come from the brief and the axes.
skipped: v0 was not used in this trial.
DesignMD compare_designs, blocks and certify_conformance were not exercised.
open_questions: Whether DesignMD export gaps are per plan or per design.

sources.title: Local notes from a design-kit trial on several directions
findings: Seven directions were produced only after choosing axes by hand; the skill gave no guidance for that.
Provider behaviors listed in this packet were each observed once on 2026-11-12.
